detail.longDescription: If you're a Google Workspace user, you'll likely know how handy Google Chat is. The team messaging application boasts spaces for teams and dedicated projects, thread-based conversations, integrated video calls, and a way to natively connect dozens of your favorite apps. But what if you need a way to connect all of the apps in your tech stack? Add Zapier to your AI assistant, tell your agent what should happen, and it builds the automation that links Google Chat to the rest of your tools. Zapier
